correctness.rationale: Let u=min(x,y),v=|x−y|. Shortest A_m representation length is v+f_m(u), with u=(m+1)q+r and f=q for r=0; f=q+1 when r>=1,q+r>=m; otherwise f=q+2r. The polygon inequalities give v+ceil(u/(m+1))≤h. Their difference occurs only when 1≤r≤m−1 and 0≤q≤m−r−1, with q+1≤h−v≤q+2r−1. Count the two orientations except once at v=0, then sum all (r,q) intervals; maximal endpoint is 2m−3 uniquely at (m−1,0), proving stabilization begins at h=2m−2 and constant m(m−1)(2m−1)/3, one less at preceding h. Independently enumerated small m,h lattice sets matched exact hole locations; finite enumeration is a check, not the universal proof.
